description_en: Publishes VPC routes to external components
kebab_example: aliyun vpc publish-vpc-route-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --target-type ECR --target-instance-id ecr-dhw2xsds50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PublishVpcRouteEntries

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在的地域ID。您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The route table ID of the route entry
fields.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The list of route entries to publish. You can specify up to 50 routes
parameters.help_zh: 需要发布的路由条目信息列表，最多支持传入50条路由
parameters.name: route_entries

parameters.help_en: The type of the route publish target
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The publish route entry target instance ID
parameters.name: target_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without publishing route entries. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request. If the check succeeds, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the resource status is queried
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会发布路由。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接查询资源状况
parameters.name: dry_run
